snippet.title: TriMatch - A Casual Puzzle Game
snippet.description:
This is an early version of TriMatch! Check out our newer videos for updated gameplay.

🧠 Simple to learn. Brutal to master. Surprisingly cozy.
Perfect for casual players, high-score hunters, and puzzle fans who want something new and satisfying.

🎮 Play the demo on Steam NOW:
👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/3063790/TriMatch/
